# Riverbend Nonprofit Network theory of change: executive summary

As of 2026-09-30.

## Headline

- **Residents get timely, good-quality services from local nonprofits**: At risk (confidence 0.15)
- **Residents' priorities shape local public decisions**: At risk (confidence 0.09)

| Level | Outcomes | Pathway status |
|-------|----------|----------------|
| Impact | 2 | 2 at risk |
| Long-term outcome | 4 | 3 at risk · 1 not started |
| Medium-term outcome | 6 | 3 at risk · 2 not started · 1 on track |

## Where attention is needed

| Outcome | Status | Because |
|---------|--------|---------|
| Members adopt and share joint positions on local issues (`oc-im-joint-positions`) | At risk | held back by `oc-st-policy-know` (at risk) |
| Local officials and funders engage members in planning (`oc-im-officials-engage`) | At risk | assumption `asm-officials-receptive` is broken or at risk, which caps what its pathway can be |
| Members turn to each other for advice and joint work (`oc-im-peer-network`) | At risk | indicator `ind-collab-maturity` is at risk (0% of the way to target; 19% expected by 2026-09-30) |
| Members routinely collaborate instead of duplicating effort (`oc-lt-collab`) | At risk | indicator `ind-collab-maturity` is at risk (0% of the way to target; 19% expected by 2026-09-30); held back by `oc-im-peer-network` (at risk); held back by `oc-im-joint-positions` (at risk) |
| Local government and funders consult members through a coordinated channel (`oc-lt-collective-voice`) | At risk | held back by `oc-im-joint-positions` (at risk); held back by `oc-im-officials-engage` (at risk); assumption `asm-officials-receptive` is broken or at risk, which caps what its pathway can be |

4 more at risk or off track are listed in the results report.

## Broken or untested critical assumptions

| Assumption | Criticality | Status | How it will be tested |
|------------|-------------|--------|-----------------------|
| The county planning office and municipal councils stay open to a standing channel with the network. (`asm-officials-receptive`) | High | At risk (assessed) | Review the county planning calendar each quarter for processes that invited members, and ask planning staff whether the channel was used. |
| Leaders put coaching-based skills into practice back at their organizations. (`asm-skills-applied`) | Critical | Untested (as written) | Interview a sample of cohort graduates six months later and score their practice with the maturity rubric. |
| Stronger, more connected, better-funded members deliver more and better services to residents. (`asm-members-deliver`) | Critical | Untested (as written) | Compare service volumes and waits at members with high and low maturity ratings, using the annual member service-count report. |

## Decisions requested

- Should the network hire a part-time civic liaison for the county channel? (by 2026-12-15)
- Should pooled services move from free trial to member fees in 2027? (by 2027-03-31)
- What should change now that the assumption "Regional funders keep funding priorities open enough that better-matched applications succeed." (`asm-funders-fit`) is at risk?
- What should change now that the assumption "The county planning office and municipal councils stay open to a standing channel with the network." (`asm-officials-receptive`) is at risk?

_Method._ Status compares progress with what the dated targets call for, within a tolerance of 10%; an outcome takes the worst of its indicators. Confidence in a link is 0.4 × evidence + 0.4 × assumptions + 0.2 × rationale, from 0 to 1; a route to impact multiplies its links' confidence.
